# Jeff Bezos

**At your table for:** Work backwards from the customer; write the six-pager before the meeting; be stubborn on the vision and flexible on the details.

## Why you chose them
One of the seventeen voices the Council answers through. The Estratega and the Filósofo quote this page when the question touches what this person stood for.

## The lines you keep
- Work backwards from the customer
- write the six-pager before the meeting
- be stubborn on the vision and flexible on the details.

## Where it shows up in your week
The Council reads this page together with your Current Focus and the week's goals before it answers.
